verdict_raw:
**Verdict: No overlapping or clipped UI** — everything (floating panels, modal, toasts, toolbars, compass, status bar) is cleanly separated and nothing is cut off. A new user would grasp "3D yard editor, terrain sculpting active" in ~5 seconds. A few minor issues, though:

1. **Toast flush against the restore dialog** — the green "Design saved!" toast (y≈119–155) sits ~1–2 px below the "Restore unsaved changes?" card (y≈65–118), visually fusing them into one clump. Add 8–12 px spacing and consider suppressing the toast while the restore prompt is open; the pairing also reads slightly contradictory ("just saved" + "unsaved changes exist").

2. **"FPS: 1" in the status bar** (bottom-left) — either the scene is rendering at a genuinely broken 1 FPS or a debug stat is leaking into user-facing UI. Both are alarming; verify render performance and hide FPS in release builds.

3. **Duplicate tools** — "Analyze" appears twice (floating panel y≈522 and bottom toolbar y≈708), and "Measure" (panel) vs "Tape Measure" (bottom toolbar) are near-duplicates. Give each tool one home to avoid confusion.

4. **Ambiguous icon** — the small phone/tablet-looking glyph at the right of the "Terrain Controls" header (x≈730, y≈310) has no clear affordance; add a tooltip or replace with a recognizable compact/fullscreen icon.

Otherwise the state is internally consistent (Tool: Raise ↔ highlighted Raise button; Brush: 8 ft ↔ slider; "Grid at Y=3 ft" ↔ Ground Level: 3 ft), so nothing else looks broken.
